# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and runtime reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the bundled engine and broadens platform support while fixing stream and encoding behavior. This unreleased line adds Uno Platform 7 compatibility, modernizes Apple and Windows support, and improves the reliability and efficiency of managed interop, image, stream, and text paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated with m156 fixes** — Refreshes the bundled Skia engine with the latest upstream Chrome m156 bug fixes and updates the GN toolchain used to build it. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5420](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5420))

## Bug Fixes

- **Managed callback interop corrected** — Uses native-compatible boolean representations for Skia stream callbacks and HarfBuzz font and Unicode callbacks, improving callback reliability across platforms. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **String and data conversion made safer** — Validates single-character text conversion correctly and creates null-terminated native data without reading beyond the managed buffer. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Image and stream handling improved** — Avoids an unnecessary intermediate allocation when copying image pixels and releases retained front-buffered managed streams correctly. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture updates synchronized** — Coordinates Android GL texture rendering with display refresh to provide smoother visual updates. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **HarfBuzz text processing allocates less** — Pools UTF-32 conversion buffers and formats feature strings without allocating unmanaged memory, reducing overhead in text shaping workflows. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Uno Platform 7 is supported** — Updates SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI and its native asset integration for Uno Platform 7. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Apple platform minimums updated** — Raises iOS and tvOS deployment targets to 14.0 and aligns native Apple builds with current platform toolchains. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU and native dependencies packaged consistently** — Includes the WebGPU implementation in WebAssembly native assets, resolves bundled HarfBuzz locally on Linux, and aligns Windows native dependencies with current MAUI releases. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
